defs.def: a natural ability to do sth well 天才；天资；天赋

ex.s: You may even learn that your kid has a talent you didn’t know about before.
ex.t: 你甚至可能发现，你的孩子有你以前不知道的天赋。

ex.s: He got up and shook Vinnie's hand warmly, “I've heard that you are a talented young woman, and I have found you charming and intelligent as well.
ex.t: 他起身热情地握住温妮的手：“我听说你是一位有天赋的年轻女子，而且我也发现你既迷人又聪明。”

ex.s: Lack of talent and time is no reason for taking no action.
ex.t: 缺乏天赋和时间不是不采取行动的理由。

ex.s: All the football player on the playground cheered loudly, say that I had a talent for football.
ex.t: 场上所有足球运动员都大声欢呼，说我很有足球天赋。

ex.s: With her talent and determination, it appears that the sky could be the limit for Alice Moore.
ex.t: 凭借她的天赋和决心，对爱丽丝·摩尔来说，似乎一切皆有可能。

ex.s: Interestingly，this trend isn’t evident in baseball. where additional individual talent keeps improving the team’s performance.
ex.t: 有趣的是，这种趋势在棒球中并不明显，因为在棒球里增加个人天赋会持续提升团队表现。

ex.s: It's not a simple matter to determine the nature of talent.
ex.t: 要确定天赋的本质并不是一件简单的事。

ex.s: No one will ever know what mix of talent, ambition, energy and luck made Dickens such a singular writer.
ex.t: 无人能知，是天赋、抱负、精力与运气的何种组合造就了如此独特的狄更斯。

ex.s: To show he was not talented in sports.
ex.t: 为了表明他在体育方面没有天赋。

ex.s: Benjamin West, the father of American painting, showed his talent for art when he was only six years of age.
ex.t: 本杰明·韦斯特，美国绘画之父，年仅六岁时就展现了他的艺术天赋。

ex.s: What did Pennington do to help Benjamin develop his talent?
ex.t: Pennington 做了什么来帮助 Benjamin 发挥他的才华？

ex.s: He developed a talent for football by kicking a ball made of rubbish around the streets.
ex.t: 他在街头踢用垃圾做成的球，练就了足球天赋。

ex.s: Another possibility is that when there is a lot of talent on a team，some players may make less effort.
ex.t: 另一种可能是，当一支球队中有太多天才时，一些球员可能会不那么努力。

ex.s: Several recent studies examined the role of talent in the sports world.
ex.t: 最近几项研究考察了天赋在体育界中的作用。

defs.def: people or a person with a natural ability to do sth well 有才能的人；人才；天才

ex.s: is fully aware of his talent and ability
ex.t: 完全清楚自己的才能和能力

ex.s: Moore wants to use her unique talent to help others find their smiles.
ex.t: 摩尔想用她独特的才能帮助他人找到笑容。

ex.s: Son: Of course I am, but I have different talents.
ex.t: 儿子：我当然会，但我有不同的才能。

ex.s: Hoping to impress some talented actors to come and work for me for nothing, I spread some throws over the sofas and lit candles to make it seem a bit more “young professional”.
ex.t: 为了给一些有才华的演员留下印象、让他们免费来为我工作，我在沙发上铺了些盖毯、点了蜡烛，让地方显得更“年轻职业范儿”一些。

ex.s: The International Olympic Committee(IOC)Young Leaders programme empowers talents to make a positive difference in their communities through sport.
ex.t: 国际奥委会（IOC）青年领袖项目赋能人才通过体育在社区产生积极影响。

ex.s: a has a natural talent for his job.
ex.t: a对他的工作有天生的才能。

ex.s: The results are mixed For football and basketball，adding talented players to a team proves a good method，but only up to the point where 70% of the players are top talent；above that level, the team’s performance begins to decline.
ex.t: 对于足球和篮球来说，效果不一：为球队增添有天赋的球员被证明是个好办法，但仅限于70%的球员都是顶尖人才的程度；超过这一水平，球队的表现就开始下滑。

ex.s: They conclude that when task interdependence is high，team performance will suffer when there is too much talent，while individual talent will have positive effects on team performance when task interdependence is lower.
ex.t: 结果喜忧参半。对于足球和篮球来说，为球队增添有天赋的球员确实是一种好方法，但仅限于当70%的球员是顶尖人才时；超过这个水平，球队的表现就开始下降。

ex.s: Sports team owners spend millions of dollars attracting top talent
ex.t: 运动队老板花费数百万美元吸引顶尖人才

ex.s: Building up a dream team is more complex than simply hiring the best talent.
ex.t: 组建梦之队比单纯雇佣最优秀的人才更复杂。

ex.s: Many teenagers love using their artistic talents to collage.
ex.t: 许多青少年喜欢用他们的艺术才能做拼贴。

ex.s: Grandfather: Yes, and you have found the career that suits your talents.
ex.t: 祖父：是的，而且你已经找到了适合你才华的事业。

ex.s: The final winner was so talented.
ex.t: 最终的获胜者非常有才华。

ex.s: Most people believe the best way to build a great team is to gather a group of the most talented individuals.
ex.t: 大多数人认为建立一个伟大团队的最佳方法是聚集一群最有才华的人。
